summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 post results earnings call held on November 4, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenues of ₹79.1 billion, up 29% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at ₹18.9 billion with a margin of 24%. Net profit was ₹9.3 billion. The net debt to EBITDA ratio was 0.62 times as on September 30, 2026. India branded formulations grew 19% year-on-year. International markets formulations revenues were ₹10 billion, up 33% year-on-year. US revenues reached ₹33.1 billion, up 21% year-on-year. Consumer wellness revenues were ₹11.2 billion, up 76% year-on-year. Medical devices revenues were ₹2.2 billion. The company received USFDA acceptance for the BLA for a Keytruda biosimilar. Phase IIb trial results for Saroglitazar in MASH were positive. The company is investing in the US launch of Saroglitazar.
